title: Add VIVO X300 PRO product listing with price 54999

requirements.text: Add a new product entry to the local products dataset for "VIVO X300 PRO" with a price tag of "54999" so it appears in the Products catalog (and is searchable/filterable like existing items).

quotes: VIVO X300 PRO AND PRICE TAG 54999

acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/data/products.ts` includes a new `Product` with `name: 'VIVO X300 PRO'` and `price: '54999'`.
The new product has a unique numeric `id` not used by existing items.
The new product renders on the Products page grid and can be found via the search input by typing "VIVO" or "X300".
No backend changes are required for the product to appear.

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/components/ui` (read-only UI components).
Do not edit any paths listed in `frontend.immutablePaths` in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep backend as a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo`; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Adding Internet Identity or user-specific product management for this item.
Integrating an external database or third-party product API.
Adding checkout, payments, or inventory management.
